name: Ranni the Witch
description: Serve Ranni, uncover Nokron’s treasure, and follow her to Moonlight Altar. Finishing her quest unlocks the Age of the Stars ending.
warning: Finish Seluvis’s Magic Scorpion Charm route before handing Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. The handover ends his quest.

notes.label: Nokron
notes.text: Defeat Starscourge Radahn to open the crater in Mistwood. The Fingerslayer Blade chest requires you to be in Ranni’s service.

notes.label: Items you need
notes.text: Speak repeatedly to Miniature Ranni at an Ainsel River Main grace. Defeating the Baleful Shadow yields the Discarded Palace Key. Use it on the locked chest in Rennala’s Grand Library for the Dark Moon Ring, which opens the way beyond Astel.

notes.label: Related quests
notes.text: Take the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni to the Carian Study Hall to reach the Cursemark of Death for Fia. Finish Rogier’s Knifeprint investigation before entering Ranni’s service if you want his dialogue.

notes.label: Amber Draught
notes.text: Offering Seluvis’s draught makes Ranni hostile. Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows can restore her cooperation.

notes.label: Age of the Stars ending
notes.text: After the final boss, use Ranni’s blue summon sign. An active Frenzied Flame hides the sign until you remove the flame with Miquella’s Needle.

steps.title: Meet Renna at the Church of Elleh
steps.hint: Return at night after receiving Torrent. Renna gives you the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.

steps.title: Defeat Royal Knight Loretta
steps.hint: Fight Loretta in the upper part of Caria Manor to open the route to the Three Sisters.

steps.title: Enter Ranni’s service
steps.hint: Climb to the top of Ranni’s Rise and agree to serve Ranni. If you are following Rogier’s quest, speak to him before pledging.

steps.title: Speak to Ranni’s three allies
steps.hint: Go downstairs and exhaust Blaidd’s, Iji’s, and Seluvis’s dialogue. Speak to Ranni again before leaving. Some allies may already have moved on.
steps.place: Lower floor of Ranni’s Rise · Three Sisters

steps.title: Meet Blaidd in Siofra River
steps.hint: Find Blaidd overlooking the river near the cliff. If the Radahn Festival is already underway, proceed to Radahn instead.

steps.title: Ask Seluvis about Nokron
steps.hint: Ask Seluvis for help reaching Nokron. Take his letter of introduction to Sellen.

steps.title: Consult Sorceress Sellen
steps.hint: Show Sellen the letter. She explains how Radahn is holding the stars in place.

steps.title: Defeat Starscourge Radahn
steps.hint: Join the festival at Redmane Castle and take the portal to the battlefield. Radahn’s defeat opens the path to Nokron.

steps.title: Descend into the Mistwood crater
steps.hint: Go to the crater south of Mistwood and descend along the rock ledges.

steps.title: Take the Fingerslayer Blade
steps.hint: Open the chest beneath the giant seated figure at the end of Night’s Sacred Ground.

steps.title: Deliver the Fingerslayer Blade
steps.hint: Give Ranni the blade and receive the Carian Inverted Statue. Finish Seluvis’s quest first if you want the Magic Scorpion Charm.

steps.title: Collect the Cursemark of Death
steps.hint: Use the statue in the Carian Study Hall and cross to the Divine Tower. This pickup is for Fia’s quest.

steps.title: Reach Ainsel River Main
steps.hint: The usual route is through the waygate at the top of Renna’s Rise. You can also reach Ainsel River Main by the coffin from Deeproot Depths.

steps.title: Pick up Miniature Ranni
steps.hint: Check the open coffin just after arriving at Ainsel River Main.

steps.title: Speak to Miniature Ranni
steps.hint: Rest at the grace and choose “Talk to miniature Ranni” three times to get a response.

steps.title: Defeat the Baleful Shadow
steps.hint: Follow the Uhl and Nokstella route through the tunnel beyond the Waterfall Basin. Defeat the shadow to receive the Discarded Palace Key.

steps.title: Open the chest for the Dark Moon Ring
steps.hint: Return to the library after defeating Rennala and unlock the chest beside her with the Discarded Palace Key.

steps.title: Reach the Grand Cloister
steps.hint: Cross the Lake of Rot and reach the Grand Cloister grace. Follow the path down to the coffin that takes you to Astel.
steps.place: Grand Cloister Site of Grace · Underground

steps.title: Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void
steps.hint: Defeat Astel and use the Dark Moon Ring to pass the seal behind the arena.

steps.title: Take the lift to Moonlight Altar
steps.hint: Ride the lift behind Astel’s arena to the Liurnia plateau.

steps.title: Put the ring on Ranni’s finger
steps.hint: Descend through the opening in the cathedral. Give Ranni the Dark Moon Ring and collect the Dark Moon Greatsword after she leaves.
steps.place: Beneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes · Liurnia

name: Sorcerer Thops
description: Help a stranded sorcerer return to Raya Lucaria Academy and recover the legacy of his research.
warning: Giving Thops the spare key sends him back to the Academy. His quest ends with his death there. Keep him alive at the church until you’re ready to send him back.

notes.label: Two keys
notes.text: Use the Glintstone Key found behind Glintstone Dragon Smarag near the Temple Quarter to enter the Academy. Thops needs the second key, on the chandelier reached from the Academy rooftops.

notes.label: After the handover
notes.text: Find him outside the Schoolhouse Classroom for Thops’s Barrier, his staff and his Bell Bearing.

steps.title: Meet Thops at the Church of Irith
steps.hint: From Lake-Facing Cliffs, go down to the ruined church and speak to Thops inside.

steps.title: Give Thops 10 runes
steps.hint: Accept his request for a small donation to unlock his sorcery shop.

steps.title: Ask about the Academy Glintstone Key
steps.hint: Exhaust his dialogue about returning to the academy.

steps.title: Find your academy entry key
steps.hint: Take the key from the corpse behind Glintstone Dragon Smarag. Use this key to enter Raya Lucaria.

steps.title: Find Thops’s spare Glintstone Key
steps.hint: From the Debate Parlor side, take the rooftop route to the church. Drop from its rafters onto the chandelier for the spare key.
steps.place: Church of the Cuckoo · Raya Lucaria

steps.title: Bring the spare key back to Thops
steps.hint: Return to Thops at the church and give him the second Academy Glintstone Key.

steps.title: Find Thops at the academy
steps.hint: From the classroom grace, head outside and check the desk for Thops. Loot his Bell Bearing, Academy Glintstone Staff, and Thops’s Barrier.

steps.title: Collect the Thops’s Barrier Ash of War
steps.hint: Return to the church and kill the Teardrop Scarab for the Ash of War.

giver.place: Church of Irith, south Liurnia · Limgrave

name: Boc the Seamster
description: Rescue Boc and help him become your personal tailor. His final dialogue determines whether he survives.
warning: Giving Boc a Larval Tear sends him to Rennala and leads to his death. Use the “You’re Beautiful” Prattling Pate near him and speak again to keep him alive.

notes.label: Sewing tools
notes.text: Recover the Sewing Needle in Coastal Cave. The Gold Sewing Needle is in the Church of Vows. Carry a piece of alterable demigod armor, such as suitable armor bought from Enia, to offer Boc the gold needle.

notes.label: Finding the Pate
notes.text: “You’re Beautiful” is in Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir. Use it in front of Boc at East Capital Rampart when he asks about his appearance.

notes.label: Optional meetings
notes.text: Grace conversations on his route can be missed as he relocates. The sewing tools and his final answer determine the tailoring outcomes.

steps.title: Free Boc from the talking tree
steps.hint: Look east of the Birdseye Telescope for the small talking tree. Roll into it or strike it once, then talk to Boc.

steps.title: Speak to Boc at Coastal Cave
steps.hint: Go inside the cave and speak to the wounded Boc beside the Site of Grace.

steps.title: Recover the Sewing Needle
steps.hint: Defeat both Demi-Human Chiefs at the end of the cave to obtain the Sewing Needle and Tailoring Tools.

steps.title: Return the Sewing Needle to Boc
steps.hint: Return to Boc by the grace and give him the Sewing Needle.

steps.title: Find Boc at Lake-Facing Cliffs
steps.hint: Look for Boc near the grace after reaching Liurnia. If he has already moved on, skip this stop.

steps.title: Find Boc at East Raya Lucaria Gate
steps.hint: Look for Boc beside the grace. If Melina offers dialogue about Boc while you rest, hear her out.

steps.title: Find Boc at Altus Highway Junction
steps.hint: Look by the grace if Boc has moved to Altus, or skip this stop if he is already in Leyndell.

steps.title: Collect the Gold Sewing Needle
steps.hint: Open the chest inside the church. It holds both the needle and the Golden Tailoring Tools.

steps.title: Give Boc the Gold Sewing Needle
steps.hint: With an alterable piece of demigod armor in your inventory, give Boc the Gold Sewing Needle. Use the location selector if he’s waiting at a different grace.

steps.title: Pick up “You’re Beautiful”
steps.hint: Loot the Prattling Pate from the corpse on the porch.

steps.title: Tell Boc he is beautiful
steps.hint: When Boc talks about rebirth, use the “You’re Beautiful” Prattling Pate within earshot. Speak to him afterward and agree. Giving him a Larval Tear leads to his death.

name: White Mask Varré
description: Earn Varré’s trust and gain early access to Mohgwyn Palace through the Pureblood Knight’s Medal.
warning: Keep Varré alive until you have the medal if you want his early route to Mohgwyn. His final invasion and bouquet come after entering the palace.

notes.label: Starting Rose Church
notes.text: Claim a Great Rune and speak to Enia at Roundtable Hold. When Varré asks about the Two Fingers, say they didn’t seem right. If you chose the other answer, talk to him again.

notes.label: Invasion trial
notes.text: Invade three times online, or defeat Magnus the Beast Claw at Writheblood Ruins offline.

notes.label: Maiden’s blood
notes.text: Use the dead maiden at the Church of Inhibition or at the Chapel of Anticipation, reached with an Imbued Sword Key at the Four Belfries.

notes.label: Alternate palace access
notes.text: The Consecrated Snowfield waygate reaches Mohgwyn Palace if the medal route is unavailable.

steps.title: Meet Varré at The First Step
steps.hint: Talk to the masked man just outside the Stranded Graveyard. You can start the main route at Rose Church if he has already moved.

steps.title: Obtain your first Great Rune
steps.hint: Defeat a shardbearer. The pin shows Godrick in Stormveil Castle, the usual early route. You can use a Great Rune from another shardbearer.

steps.title: Speak to Finger Reader Enia
steps.hint: Fast travel to the Roundtable Hold. With your first Great Rune, enter the newly opened chamber and speak with Enia. Then head to Rose Church.

steps.title: Read Varré’s message for Bravo!
steps.hint: Read the message Varré leaves by his old spot after moving to Rose Church to learn the Bravo! gesture.

steps.title: Receive the Festering Bloody Fingers
steps.hint: Talk to Varré at the church entrance. Choose “They didn’t seem right” when he asks about the Two Fingers, then take the five Festering Bloody Fingers.

steps.title: Complete the invasion trial
steps.hint: Offline, use the red sign to invade Magnus and defeat him, or complete three invasion attempts. Three online invasions also count toward this step.
steps.place: Magnus’s red sign · Writheblood Ruins, Altus Plateau

steps.title: Receive the Lord of Blood’s Favor
steps.hint: Return to Varré after finishing the trial. Choose “Anoint me” to receive the white cloth.

steps.title: Soak the cloth in maiden’s blood
steps.hint: Use the cloth on the dead maiden inside the Church of Inhibition. The corpse at the Chapel of Anticipation also works. Reach it through the Four Belfries waygate marked Precipice of Anticipation.
steps.place: Maiden’s corpse · Church of Inhibition, Liurnia

steps.title: Offer your finger to Varré
steps.hint: Bring the stained cloth back to Varré and choose “Offer finger” to receive the reusable Bloody Finger.

steps.title: Receive the Pureblood Knight’s Medal
steps.hint: Speak to Varré again after receiving the Bloody Finger to collect the medal.

steps.title: Reach Mohgwyn Palace
steps.hint: Use the medal from your inventory to fast travel to Mohgwyn Palace. Activate the Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance grace nearby.

steps.title: Invade and defeat Varré
steps.hint: Follow the mausoleum tunnels toward the Midpoint grace. Use Varré’s red sign near the exit of the tunnel and defeat him in his world.

steps.title: Collect Varré’s Bouquet
steps.hint: Back in your world, speak to the wounded Varré by the invasion sign until his dialogue ends. Loot Varré’s Bouquet from his body.

name: Melina, the Kindling Maiden
description: Melina’s accord unlocks leveling and Torrent. Her journey ends with a decision at the Forge of the Giants.
warning: Inheriting the Frenzied Flame before the Forge makes Melina leave and lets you light it yourself. The flame overrides the other endings until you remove it.

notes.label: Accepting the accord
notes.text: Accept to unlock leveling and the Spectral Steed Whistle. If you decline, you can accept it later through a grace.

notes.label: Forge decision
notes.text: Agreeing at the Forge advances the story to Crumbling Farum Azula. Defeating Maliketh later is what turns Leyndell into the Ashen Capital.

notes.label: Ending variation
notes.text: Inherit the flame before lighting the Forge and keep it through the finale to see Melina’s scene in the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending. Millicent’s route supplies the item needed to remove the flame.

giver.hint: Gatefront is a reliable early place to meet her. She can appear at other qualifying Sites of Grace.

steps.title: Accept Melina’s accord
steps.hint: Rest at Gatefront or another qualifying grace and accept the accord to receive Torrent.

steps.title: Accept the invitation to Roundtable Hold
steps.hint: When Melina offers to take you to the Hold, accept her invitation. The offer may occur at several Sites of Grace.

steps.title: Defeat Morgott at the Elden Throne
steps.hint: Reach the throne through Leyndell and defeat the Omen King.
steps.place: Morgott, the Omen King · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Receive the Rold Medallion
steps.hint: Check the Erdtree’s thorns, then rest at the Elden Throne and talk to Melina.

steps.title: Defeat the Fire Giant
steps.hint: Cross the Mountaintops and defeat the guardian of the Forge.
steps.place: Fire Giant · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Make the decision at the Forge
steps.hint: Speak to Melina at the Forge grace and say you are ready. The Frenzied Flame route uses a different prompt at the same grace.
steps.place: Forge of The Giants · Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Merchant Kalé
description: Follow Kalé’s tip about the Mistwood howl to meet Blaidd.
warning: Speak to Kalé about the howl while he is alive to get Finger Snap and his directions. Killing him removes those conversations.

notes.label: Trigger
notes.text: Hear the howl near Mistwood Ruins, then return to Kalé at the Church of Elleh and ask about it. Use Finger Snap below Blaidd on the ruins.

notes.label: Related quest
notes.text: This is an early introduction to Blaidd. His later appearances during Ranni’s quest can advance even if you miss it.

steps.title: Meet Kalé at the Church of Elleh
steps.hint: Speak to the merchant at the ruined church.

steps.title: Hear the howl in Mistwood
steps.hint: Approach the ruins and listen for Blaidd’s howl, then return to the church.

steps.title: Ask Kalé about the howl
steps.hint: Choose the dialogue about the howling in the woods to learn Finger Snap.

name: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
description: Meet Blaidd in Mistwood and follow his encounters through Darriwil, Ranni’s service, and the Radahn Festival.
warning: Do the Mistwood and Darriwil encounters early if you want their dialogue and reward. Blaidd relocates as Ranni’s quest and the festival advance.

notes.label: First meeting
notes.text: Hear the Mistwood howl and ask Merchant Kalé for Finger Snap. After defeating Darriwil, speak to Blaidd outside the Evergaol for his reward.

notes.label: Evergaol choice
notes.text: If Iji imprisons Blaidd in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, releasing him is optional. His final encounter still occurs after you complete Ranni’s route.

notes.label: After Ranni
notes.text: Blaidd becomes hostile at Ranni’s Rise when her quest is finished. Defeat him there for his equipment, then tell Iji what happened.

steps.title: Call Blaidd down in Mistwood
steps.hint: Learn Finger Snap from Kalé and use it beneath the wolf’s perch. Speak to Blaidd about Darriwil.

steps.title: Defeat Bloodhound Knight Darriwil
steps.hint: Enter Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Blaidd can help if you already met him.

steps.title: Speak to Blaidd after Darriwil
steps.hint: Speak to Blaidd beside the evergaol after the fight to receive a Somber Smithing Stone [2]. Speak again to hear about Iji.

steps.title: Meet Blaidd in Ranni’s service
steps.hint: Join Ranni and talk to Blaidd’s apparition in the lower room of her tower.

steps.title: Find Blaidd in Siofra River
steps.hint: Speak to Blaidd near the cliff edge about the route to Nokron.

steps.title: Take part in the Radahn Festival
steps.hint: Defeat Radahn, then speak to Blaidd on the battlefield before leaving.

steps.title: Check Blaidd’s prison
steps.hint: After the festival, hear Blaidd at the evergaol and choose whether to let him out.

steps.title: Return to Ranni’s Rise after her quest
steps.hint: After the Dark Moon Ring ceremony, return outside the tower and face Blaidd.

name: Roderika
description: Help Roderika settle at Roundtable Hold and learn spirit tuning from Hewg.
warning: Entering Liurnia can move Roderika to the Hold before you hand over the Chrysalids’ Memento. Spirit tuning is still available through her and Hewg.

notes.label: Memento and seed
notes.text: Find the memento on the pile of bodies in Stormveil and give it to her while she is at Stormhill Shack. If she leaves without it, check the shack for a Golden Seed.

notes.label: Spirit tuning
notes.text: Relay their dialogue back and forth, then reload the Hold. Use Grave Glovewort for ordinary ashes and Ghost Glovewort for renowned ashes.

notes.label: Jellyfish ashes
notes.text: Ask Roderika about the spirits to get the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes needed for Aureliette’s reunion.

steps.title: Speak to Roderika at Stormhill Shack
steps.hint: Exhaust her dialogue at the shack. She gives you the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes.

steps.title: Recover the Chrysalids’ Memento
steps.hint: Search the corpse pile by the grafted scion hall in Stormveil Castle.

steps.title: Deliver the memento
steps.hint: Give it to Roderika if she is still at the shack. She can move to the Hold without this.

steps.title: Introduce Roderika and Hewg
steps.hint: At the Hold, go back and forth between Roderika and Hewg to discuss her talent and ask Hewg to look after her.

steps.title: Unlock spirit tuning
steps.hint: Reload the Hold and speak to Roderika across the corridor from Hewg.

name: Kenneth Haight
description: Reclaim Fort Haight and help Kenneth find a successor for Limgrave.
warning: Keep Kenneth alive if you want his Fort Haight dialogue and his part in the Stormveil succession.

notes.label: Taking service
notes.text: Report back after killing the knight at Fort Haight. Agree to enter Kenneth’s service and speak to him again at his fort. If you decline at first, you can accept later at the fort.

notes.label: Throne room
notes.text: Progress Nepheli with the Stormhawk King and defeat Morgott. Return to Stormveil after Kenneth has discussed looking for a ruler at his fort.

steps.title: Accept Kenneth’s request
steps.hint: Speak with Kenneth on top of the fallen arch in eastern Limgrave until he asks you to reclaim his fort.

steps.title: Clear Fort Haight
steps.hint: Defeat the Godrick knight on the ramparts and collect Bloody Slash.

steps.title: Report to Kenneth and accept his service
steps.hint: Return to the arch for the Erdsteel Dagger and agree to serve him.

steps.title: Speak to Kenneth inside his fort
steps.hint: Return to the upper ramparts and exhaust his dialogue about finding a worthy ruler.

steps.title: Find Kenneth in Stormveil’s throne room
steps.hint: Advance Nepheli’s quest and defeat Morgott. Rest at Godrick’s grace and find Kenneth in the throne room.

name: Gatekeeper Gostoc
description: Choose an entrance to Stormveil and follow Gostoc to the throne room after Godrick’s defeat.
warning: Keep Gostoc alive for his later shop stock, including the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone sold after Nepheli takes the throne.

notes.label: The gate
notes.text: Gostoc recommends the side path. You can ask him to open the main gate if you want to use the front entrance.

notes.label: Stolen runes
notes.text: While he stalks you in Stormveil before Godrick’s defeat, Gostoc can take a cut of runes you drop there. Killing him to reclaim them sacrifices his later shop and dialogue.

notes.label: Throne room
notes.text: Progress Nepheli and Kenneth, then revisit after Morgott. Gostoc joins them if alive.

steps.title: Discuss the routes into Stormveil
steps.hint: Speak to Gostoc in the room to the side of the main gate and choose a way in.

steps.title: Talk to Gostoc after defeating Godrick
steps.hint: Return to Godrick’s arena and speak to Gostoc about his freedom.

steps.title: Find Gostoc in the throne room
steps.hint: Complete Nepheli’s succession and speak to Gostoc in the throne room. His shop then offers an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

name: Nepheli Loux
description: Help Nepheli recover her purpose and take the throne at Stormveil Castle.
warning: Giving Nepheli Seluvis’s Potion ends her succession route. Give it to Gideon for disposal to protect her while keeping Seluvis’s route available.

notes.label: Stormhawk King
notes.text: Use the Four Belfries portal for the Chapel of Anticipation. Get an Imbued Sword Key to open it, then find the Stormhawk King in the chapel’s side room.

notes.label: Taking the throne
notes.text: Give Nepheli the Stormhawk King, progress Kenneth at Fort Haight, and defeat Morgott. Rest at Godrick’s grace and check the throne room. Finish this before defeating Maliketh to protect Gideon’s dialogue.

notes.label: Reward
notes.text: Nepheli gives an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at the throne. If Gostoc is alive, he also sells one.

steps.title: Meet Nepheli in Stormveil Castle
steps.hint: Find her in the side room near the path to Godrick’s arena.

steps.title: Receive the Arsenal Charm
steps.hint: After defeating Godrick, speak to Nepheli at the Hold until she gives you the charm.

steps.title: Speak to Nepheli in the Albinauric village
steps.hint: Find her beneath the village bridge and exhaust the dialogue. Omenkiller is just ahead.
steps.place: Nepheli Loux (Village of the Albinaurics) · Liurnia

steps.title: Ask Gideon about Nepheli
steps.hint: Speak to her downstairs at the Hold, then ask Gideon about her despair. Return to her and discuss what Gideon told you.

steps.title: Recover the Stormhawk King
steps.hint: Use the Precipice of Anticipation waygate at the Four Belfries and find the ashes in the chapel’s upper entry.

steps.title: Give Nepheli the Stormhawk King
steps.hint: Hand her the ashes downstairs at the Hold. Keep Seluvis’s potion away from her if you want this route.

steps.title: Meet the new ruler of Limgrave
steps.hint: Finish Kenneth’s fort dialogue, defeat Morgott, then rest at Godrick’s grace and talk to Nepheli in the throne room.

name: Sorcerer Rogier
description: Investigate the corpse below Stormveil and the Night of the Black Knives with Rogier.
warning: Finish Rogier’s Black Knifeprint investigation before formally joining Ranni. Joining first can cut off his investigation dialogue.

notes.label: Evidence
notes.text: Examine the bloodstain beneath Stormveil, then speak to Rogier. Fia can give a clue after an embrace. The Black Knifeprint comes from the hidden Black Knife Assassin in Black Knife Catacombs.

notes.label: Ranni and D
notes.text: Follow Rogier’s advice when asking Ranni about the cursemark. After Rogier dies, check his belongings for the letter pointing to D’s brother.

steps.title: Speak to Rogier in Stormveil
steps.hint: Talk to him in the chapel in Stormveil Castle.

steps.title: Accept Rogier’s Rapier
steps.hint: After Godrick, talk to Rogier on the Roundtable balcony and tell him you defeated Godrick.

steps.title: Investigate the body below Stormveil
steps.hint: Reach the lowest part of Stormveil beneath the courtyard and examine Rogier’s bloodstain next to the enormous face.

steps.title: Discuss the corpse with Rogier
steps.hint: Ask him about the face at the Hold, then ask Fia in secret for her lead on the Black Knifeprint.

steps.title: Recover the Black Knifeprint
steps.hint: In Black Knife Catacombs, find the hidden assassin fight beyond the illusory wall and defeat the assassin.

steps.title: Let Rogier examine the Knifeprint
steps.hint: Hand over the Knifeprint, reload, and ask what he learned about Ranni.

steps.title: Ask Ranni about the cursemark
steps.hint: Meet Ranni at her rise, report back to Rogier, then take his suggestion to enter her service.

steps.title: Read Rogier’s letter
steps.hint: After Rogier falls asleep and later dies, return for his gear and letter pointing to D’s brother.

name: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
description: Accompany Yura as he hunts Bloody Fingers from Limgrave to the Second Church of Marika.
warning: Finish Yura’s Academy Gate encounter before entering the Mountaintops. Shabriri later takes over his body and can cut off Yura’s earlier dialogue and rewards.

notes.label: Academy reward
notes.text: Use Yura’s red summon sign on the bridge by the Main Academy Gate to help him. Victory grants Raptor of the Mists.

notes.label: Second Church
notes.text: His Nagakiba is recoverable through his route. Defeat Eleonora for the Purifying Crystal Tear. Mix that tear into the Wondrous Physick to counter Mohg’s blood ritual.

notes.label: Related quest
notes.text: Shabriri’s later choice concerns the Frenzied Flame. Completing Yura’s hunt does not choose an ending.

steps.title: Meet Yura by Agheel Lake
steps.hint: Find him beneath the ruined arch south of the lake and hear his warning about the dragon.

steps.title: Defeat Bloody Finger Nerijus
steps.hint: Enter the Murkwater ravine from the lake and defeat the invader. Yura can intervene during the fight.

steps.title: Speak to Yura after Nerijus
steps.hint: Continue north through the ravine and speak to him beneath the overhang.
steps.place: Bloody Finger Hunter Yura (Murkwater Cave) · Limgrave

steps.title: Help Yura at the Academy gate
steps.hint: Walk north over the bridge from the Main Academy Gate grace and use the red sign without activating the seal. Speak to him afterward.

steps.title: Speak to Yura at the Second Church of Marika
steps.hint: Find him inside the church and take Nagakiba after the conversation.
steps.place: Yura (Second Church of Marika) · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Defeat Eleonora and recover the Crystal Tear
steps.hint: Defeat the invading Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika to obtain Eleonora’s Poleblade and the Purifying Crystal Tear.
steps.place: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger · Altus Plateau

name: Patches
description: Spare Patches and follow his changing locations, from Murkwater Cave through Volcano Manor and back.
warning: Stop attacking when he surrenders. Finish his Tragoth contract and claim the Magma Whip Candlestick before killing Rykard.

notes.label: Optional encounters
notes.text: The trapped chest, Scenic Isle conversation, and Rainbow Stone cliff can be missed as he moves. Complete Tanith’s first contract and speak to Patches to get his own letter.

notes.label: After Rykard
notes.text: Talk to Patches in the manor and check the Shaded Castle for the Dancer’s Castanets. Giving them to Tanith is optional and has no reward.

notes.label: Returning to Murkwater
notes.text: Spare him again once he recognizes you in the rematch to get Patches’ Crouch and reopen his shop after a reload.

steps.title: Spare Patches in Murkwater Cave
steps.hint: Open the chest, fight him until he surrenders, then stop attacking and choose to forgive him.

steps.title: Return after opening his trapped chest
steps.hint: Open the second chest, then return to the cave and talk to Patches after escaping the woods.

steps.title: Speak to Patches at Scenic Isle
steps.hint: Look for him near the grace in Liurnia and hear his advice about the Academy’s abductor.

steps.title: Follow the trail of Rainbow Stones
steps.hint: Approach the marked cliff by Mt. Gelmir’s Rainbow Stones for Patches’ encounter.

steps.title: Take Patches’ Volcano Manor request
steps.hint: Complete Tanith’s first contract, then talk to Patches in the hallway to get his letter.

steps.title: Defeat Great Horned Tragoth
steps.hint: After defeating the Magma Wyrm in Ruin-Strewn Precipice, use the red sign in its arena.

steps.title: Claim the Magma Whip Candlestick
steps.hint: Report the contract to Patches and reload before asking about your reward. Finish this before killing Rykard.

steps.title: Speak to Patches after defeating Rykard
steps.hint: Defeat Rykard, then speak to Patches in the Volcano Manor hallway. Exhaust his dialogue and reload the area so he can move to the Shaded Castle.

steps.title: Receive the Dancer’s Castanets
steps.hint: After Rykard dies, find Patches outside the Shaded Castle boss room.

steps.title: Offer the castanets to Tanith
steps.hint: Find Tanith in Rykard’s arena and show her the castanets. This scene gives no reward.

steps.title: Reconcile with Patches back in Murkwater Cave
steps.hint: Return to the original cave, wait for recognition during the rematch, and spare him again.

name: Sorceress Sellen
description: Study under Sellen, find the primeval sorcerers, and choose who survives her conflict with Jerren.
warning: Keep Sellen’s imprisoned body alive until you can take her Primal Glintstone. The summon-sign decision outside the Grand Library gives different rewards and resolves the quest.

notes.label: Required items and progress
notes.text: Show Sellen Comet Azur to get the Sellian Sealbreaker for Lusat. Defeat Radahn as the route requires, take her Primal Glintstone at Witchbane Ruins, and implant it in the body in the hidden ruins near Ranni’s Rise.

notes.label: Help Sellen
notes.text: Use the gold sign to help Sellen and defeat Jerren. This route awards the Glintstone Kris, unlocks Shard Spiral for purchase, and lets you recover Azur’s and Lusat’s sets.

notes.label: Help Jerren
notes.text: Use the red sign to challenge Sellen. Jerren gives an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and Sellen leaves her Bell Bearing and crown. Azur’s and Lusat’s sets are tied to Sellen’s side.

steps.title: Become Sellen’s student
steps.hint: Defeat the Mad Pumpkin Head beneath Waypoint Ruins and agree to study with Sellen.

steps.title: Receive Comet Azur
steps.hint: Speak to the silent sorcerer beyond Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir.

steps.title: Show Sellen Comet Azur
steps.hint: Agree to restore the primeval current and ask about her favor to get the Sealbreaker.

steps.title: Find Master Lusat
steps.hint: Open the sealed passage in Sellia Hideaway, take Stars of Ruin and report his whereabouts to Sellen.

steps.title: Take Sellen’s Primal Glintstone
steps.hint: After defeating Radahn and progressing her dialogue, visit her captive body in Witchbane Ruins.

steps.title: Restore Sellen in a new body
steps.hint: Enter Seluvis’s hidden cellar and use the Primal Glintstone on the spare body behind the illusory wall.

steps.title: Choose a side outside the Grand Library
steps.hint: Use the gold sign to aid Sellen or the red sign to aid Jerren. Talk to the survivor for the route’s final reward.

name: Iron Fist Alexander
description: Follow Alexander from Saintsbridge to his final duel in Crumbling Farum Azula.
warning: Killing Alexander early gives the weaker Warrior Jar Shard and ends his route to the Shard of Alexander and the Innards required by Jar-Bairn.

notes.label: Optional stops
notes.text: Gael Tunnel is available before the Radahn Festival moves him to Redmane Castle. His plaza conversation is optional and can be missed after Radahn’s defeat. Speak to him on the battlefield until he repeats himself.

notes.label: Oil Pot
notes.text: The Liurnia rescue above Jarburg is optional. To craft an Oil Pot, buy Nomadic Warrior’s Cookbook [17] from the merchant in Siofra River and use a Melted Mushroom with a Cracked Pot.

notes.label: Final duel
notes.text: Speak to him at the lava near Fort Laiedd and progress past the Fire Giant to Farum Azula. Accept the duel there, then speak to him afterward to collect the shard and Innards.

steps.title: Free Alexander at Saintsbridge
steps.hint: Agree to help and strike his back with a heavy attack to knock him out of the hole.

steps.title: Talk to Alexander at Gael Tunnel
steps.hint: Speak to him by the Rear Gael Tunnel grace. If the Radahn Festival has already started, he has moved to Redmane Castle.

steps.title: Meet Alexander at the festival
steps.hint: Speak to Alexander in Redmane Castle plaza when the festival is active.

steps.title: Speak to Alexander on Radahn’s battlefield
steps.hint: After beating Radahn, speak to Alexander near the battlefield grace and keep talking until he repeats himself.

steps.title: Free Alexander with an Oil Pot
steps.hint: Above Jarburg, throw an Oil Pot at the stuck jar before striking his back again.

steps.title: Meet Alexander in the lava
steps.hint: At Mt. Gelmir, stand on the safe rock by Alexander in the lava and speak to him for the Jar helmet.
steps.place: Alexander Iron Fist (Mt. Gelmir) · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Duel Alexander in Farum Azula
steps.hint: From Dragon Temple Lift, cross the broken structures to his platform. Win the duel and talk to him for the Shard and Innards.
steps.place: Alexander Iron Fist (Crumbling Farum Azula) · Crumbling Farum Azula

name: Irina & Castellan Edgar
description: Deliver Irina’s letter to Castle Morne and follow Edgar’s reaction to what happens on the road.
warning: Keep Edgar alive for the letter and Revenger’s Shack encounters. Irina’s death is part of this route and cannot be prevented by clearing Castle Morne first.

notes.label: Letter and castle
notes.text: Accept the letter, give it to Edgar on the ramparts, defeat the Leonine Misbegotten, and tell Edgar about the victory so he can return to Irina.

notes.label: Related quest
notes.text: Defeating Edgar the Revenger at Revenger’s Shack yields a Shabriri Grape for Hyetta. Collect the drop before leaving. If you already killed Edgar at Castle Morne or by Irina’s body, reload and check where he died for the grape.

steps.title: Accept Irina’s letter
steps.hint: Speak to Irina south of the Bridge of Sacrifice and agree to carry her letter.

steps.title: Deliver the letter to Edgar
steps.hint: Find him on the upper ramparts of Castle Morne and hand over the letter.

steps.title: Defeat Leonine Misbegotten
steps.hint: Reach the beach below Castle Morne and recover the Grafted Blade Greatsword.

steps.title: Tell Edgar the castle is safe
steps.hint: Return to the ramparts and tell him what happened so he can leave his post.

steps.title: Find Edgar with Irina
steps.hint: Return to where you met Irina and speak to Edgar at her body.

steps.title: Defeat Edgar the Revenger
steps.hint: Go to Revenger’s Shack in western Liurnia, defeat Edgar’s invasion and collect the Shabriri Grape.

name: Brother Corhyn & Goldmask
description: Reunite Corhyn with Goldmask, uncover Radagon’s secret, and earn the rune for the Age of Order ending.
warning: Reveal and report the secret while Leyndell is still the Royal Capital. Defeating Maliketh replaces the city and can end the unfinished route.

notes.label: Spell requirement
notes.text: Find the Golden Order Principia in Erdtree Sanctuary and give it to Corhyn or Miriel. Cast Law of Regression with a sacred seal and 37 Intelligence at Radagon’s statue. Temporary Intelligence boosts count.

notes.label: Before the capital changes
notes.text: Tell Goldmask what the statue revealed. Check for him and Corhyn near Stargazers’ Ruins in the Mountaintops before finishing Farum Azula.

notes.label: Age of Order ending
notes.text: Collect the Mending Rune of Perfect Order in the Ashen Capital. Choose it at Fractured Marika after the final boss while free of the Frenzied Flame.

steps.title: Meet Corhyn at the Hold
steps.hint: Introduce yourself to Corhyn and ask about the Light. After reaching Altus, ask about his departure before he leaves.

steps.title: Find Corhyn in Altus Plateau
steps.hint: Speak to him by the map monument north of Altus Highway Junction and ask about Goldmask.

steps.title: Find Goldmask on the broken bridge
steps.hint: Reach the north end of the broken bridge and interact with Goldmask.

steps.title: Tell Corhyn where Goldmask is
steps.hint: Return to the highway and tell Corhyn Goldmask’s whereabouts, then speak to both on the bridge.

steps.title: Find the Golden Order Principia
steps.hint: Climb to the upper floor of the Erdtree Sanctuary and take the prayerbook. Give it to Corhyn or Miriel and learn Law of Regression.

steps.title: Reveal the secret of Radagon’s statue
steps.hint: Cast Law of Regression in front of the statue west of Erdtree Sanctuary. Read the new message.
steps.place: Radagon’s statue, Erdtree Sanctuary · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Tell Goldmask the secret
steps.hint: Find the pair by the Royal Colosseum and tell Goldmask what the statue revealed, before Leyndell becomes Ash.
steps.place: Brother Corhyn & Goldmask  (Fourth Location) · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Visit the pair in the Mountaintops
steps.hint: Look on the bridge south of Stargazers’ Ruins to hear Corhyn’s doubts about Goldmask.
steps.place: Brother Corhyn & Goldmask (Fifth Location) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Recover the Mending Rune of Perfect Order
steps.hint: Once Leyndell is Ash, approach Goldmask’s body along the cliffs below the colosseum.

name: D, Hunter of the Dead & D’s Twin
description: Follow D’s Deathroot hunt and decide whether his twin receives the Twinned Set.
warning: Giving the Twinned Set to D’s brother sets up his confrontation with Fia. Fia’s Mending Rune can be earned without giving him the armor.

notes.label: Getting the set
notes.text: Show D a Deathroot to learn the way to Gurranq. Give D the Weathered Dagger from Fia, then recover the Twinned Set in the room beyond Hewg after reloading.

notes.label: Armor choice
notes.text: Offer the complete set to the twin in Siofra Aqueduct to continue his branch. After Fia’s route concludes, follow his dialogue and reload to recover the set and the Inseparable Sword.

giver.place: D, Hunter of the Dead · Limgrave

steps.title: Hear D’s warning about Summonwater
steps.hint: Speak to D by the corpse on the road. If he has moved, find him at the Roundtable Hold.
steps.place: D, Hunter of the Dead · Limgrave

steps.title: Show D a Deathroot
steps.hint: Defeat a Tibia Mariner, show D the Deathroot and agree to meet the clergyman. D reveals a waygate near the Third Church of Marika.

steps.title: Give D the Weathered Dagger
steps.hint: Accept Fia’s dagger and hand it to D at the Hold.

steps.title: Recover D’s Twinned armor
steps.hint: Reload the Hold and search the newly opened room beyond Hewg for D’s body.

steps.title: Give D’s twin the armor
steps.hint: Find the twin at the end of Siofra Aqueduct before the Valiant Gargoyles. Give him the complete Twinned set.

steps.title: Recover the Inseparable Sword and armor
steps.hint: After Fia’s quest, speak to the twin in Deeproot Depths. Return after reloading to collect the sword and armor.

name: Fia, Deathbed Companion
description: Follow Fia to Deeproot Depths and earn the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince to unlock the Age of the Duskborn ending.
warning: Leave Fia alive and choose “No, I want to be held” when she asks why you came to Deeproot Depths. Killing her before she gives you the rune blocks the Age of the Duskborn ending.

notes.label: Embrace
notes.text: A Baldachin’s Blessing held in your inventory lowers maximum HP. Use the blessing and let its effect expire to remove the penalty.

notes.label: Cursemark
notes.text: Give Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade to receive the Carian Inverted Statue. Use it at the Carian Study Hall, then collect the Cursemark of Death at the Divine Tower of Liurnia and give it to Fia.

notes.label: D’s brother
notes.text: Handing over the Twinned Set changes the aftermath of Fia’s quest. The armor handover is optional for the rune.

notes.label: Age of the Duskborn ending
notes.text: Enter Fia’s dream and defeat Lichdragon Fortissax, then collect the rune. Choose it at Fractured Marika while free of the Frenzied Flame.

steps.title: Accept Fia’s embrace
steps.hint: Speak to Fia by the bed and let her hold you. You can ask her to talk in secret from the embrace.

steps.title: Receive the Weathered Dagger
steps.hint: After enough story progress, let Fia hold you and accept her favor.

steps.title: Give the dagger to D
steps.hint: Bring Fia’s dagger to D in the main room of the Hold.

steps.title: Find Fia in the room beyond Hewg
steps.hint: Reload the Hold and speak to Fia over D’s body.

steps.title: Defeat Fia’s Champions
steps.hint: Reach Deeproot Depths, climb the roots and cross to the arena, then defeat all waves.

steps.title: Give Fia the Cursemark of Death
steps.hint: After finding the mark in Ranni’s route, choose to be held and give it to Fia.

steps.title: Defeat Lichdragon Fortissax
steps.hint: Exhaust Fia’s dialogue and reload until she sleeps. Touch her to enter the Deathbed Dream and win the fight.

steps.title: Take the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince
steps.hint: Return to Fia’s body and collect the rune. It unlocks the Age of the Duskborn ending.

name: Diallos
description: Follow Diallos after he loses Lanya and see what becomes of him in Jarburg.
warning: Keep Diallos and the Jarburg residents alive for the village’s final scene. Defeating Rykard can move the manor cast past their earlier dialogue.

notes.label: Manor to Jarburg
notes.text: Find Diallos in Liurnia, then talk to him at Volcano Manor while he is there. In Jarburg, exhaust Jar-Bairn’s dialogue and reload or rest to advance their scenes.

notes.label: After the attack
notes.text: Speak to the wounded Diallos to resolve his story. Return after a reload for his dropped equipment.

steps.title: Ask Diallos about Lanya
steps.hint: Speak to Diallos in the Hold and hear who he is searching for.

steps.title: Find Diallos in Academy Gate Town
steps.hint: Cross the flooded roofs to find him standing over Lanya. Ask him what happened.

steps.title: Hear Diallos’s next plan
steps.hint: Return to the Hold and exhaust his dialogue about the recusants.

steps.title: Find Diallos at Volcano Manor
steps.hint: Join the Manor and speak to him in the drawing room. Return after the Manor requests for his changing dialogue.

steps.title: Speak to Diallos in Jarburg
steps.hint: Advance Jar-Bairn’s dialogue and return when Diallos has taken up residence as the new potentate.

steps.title: Find Diallos after the attack
steps.hint: Reload Jarburg until the attack occurs. Talk to the injured Diallos in the road, then recheck his spot for the drops.

name: Dung Eater
description: Gather five Seedbed Curses for the Dung Eater to unlock the Blessing of Despair ending, or use Seluvis’s Potion to turn him into a puppet.
warning: Killing his body or giving him Seluvis’s Potion ends the rune route. Leave him alive and save five Seedbed Curses if you want the Blessing of Despair ending.

notes.label: Opening the cell
notes.text: Show a Seedbed Curse to his red spirit to get the Sewer-Gaol Key. Free him beneath Leyndell, then defeat his invasion in the outer moat and return to his spirit.

notes.label: Curse supply
notes.text: Obtain the curse in the Royal Capital’s Fortified Manor before Maliketh changes the city. The other sources are the East Capital Rampart route, Volcano Manor, two corpses in Elphael, and Boggart’s moat encounter.

notes.label: Boggart
notes.text: If Boggart has moved to the moat when the invasion is due, he can become a victim. Resolve the invasion before moving Boggart there if you want to preserve him.

notes.label: Blessing of Despair ending
notes.text: Feed the imprisoned Dung Eater five Seedbed Curses. Take his Mending Rune of the Fell Curse and choose it at Fractured Marika while free of the Frenzied Flame.

steps.title: Meet the red spirit at the Hold
steps.hint: Reach Altus and find Dung Eater in the room beyond the Twin Maiden Husks.

steps.title: Show him a Seedbed Curse
steps.hint: Find any Seedbed Curse and show it to him to receive the Sewer-Gaol Key.

steps.title: Free Dung Eater from his cell
steps.hint: Enter the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, open his cell and tell him to leave.

steps.title: Defeat his invasion in the outer moat
steps.hint: Read his message at the Hold and go to Leyndell’s outer moat. Fight his invading form.

steps.title: Speak to his spirit again
steps.hint: Return to the Hold and hear him ask you to feed Seedbed Curses to his real body.

steps.title: Feed him five Seedbed Curses
steps.hint: Bring five curses to the bound Dung Eater. An alternate Seluvis potion route ends the Mending Rune route.

steps.title: Collect the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
steps.hint: Take it from the cell after the final curse. It unlocks the Blessing of Despair ending.

name: Ensha of the Royal Remains
description: Meet Gideon’s silent guard and survive his ambush at Roundtable Hold.
warning: Picking up a half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion can trigger the ambush on your next return to the Hold. Meet Ensha first if you want his gesture.

notes.label: Trigger
notes.text: Old Albus gives the right half in the Village of the Albinaurics. The left half is beyond Commander Niall in Castle Sol.

notes.label: After the fight
notes.text: Defeat Ensha, then return to his usual place outside Gideon’s study for the Royal Remains armor. Speak to Gideon about Latenna.

steps.title: Meet Ensha outside Gideon’s study
steps.hint: Interact with the silent guard to learn the What Do You Want? gesture.

steps.title: Receive Albus’s secret medallion half
steps.hint: Find the disguised Albus in the Village of the Albinaurics and take the right half.

steps.title: Survive Ensha’s ambush
steps.hint: Travel to the Hold after getting the secret medallion half and defeat Ensha. Check his old spot for the Royal Remains Set.

name: Sir Gideon Ofnir
description: Trade information about demigods and hidden regions with Gideon before facing him in the Ashen Capital.
warning: Report your discoveries to Gideon at Roundtable Hold before defeating Maliketh. His earlier dialogue and rewards become unavailable once he leaves.

notes.label: Haligtree lead
notes.text: After Ensha’s ambush, ask Gideon about the secret medallion. His clue leads to Latenna at Slumbering Wolf’s Shack.

notes.label: Reporting discoveries
notes.text: Tell him about Mohgwyn Palace and the Haligtree while he is still at the Hold. His other reports depend on your progress against their demigods.

steps.title: Speak with Gideon at the Hold
steps.hint: Return after your first Great Rune and hear Gideon’s briefing in his study.

steps.title: Ask about the secret medallion
steps.hint: After defeating Ensha, ask Gideon about him until he sends you to look for Latenna.

steps.title: Report what you discovered
steps.hint: Tell Gideon about the path to the Haligtree, Malenia, or Mohg’s cocoon for the corresponding rewards before the capital turns to Ash.

steps.title: Defeat Gideon in the Capital of Ash
steps.hint: After Maliketh, go to the former Erdtree Sanctuary and defeat Gideon.
steps.place: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing · Altus Plateau

name: Smithing Master Hewg
description: Use Hewg’s smithing services and connect him with Roderika to unlock spirit tuning.
warning: The Forge and later story events change Hewg’s dialogue. Hear his earlier conversations before advancing if you want the full story. His smithing service remains available.

notes.label: Spirit tuning
notes.text: Tell Hewg about Roderika, relay the answer to her, and ask him to teach her. Reload Roundtable Hold to find her tuning spirits.

notes.label: Upgrade materials
notes.text: Standard weapons go to +25 with an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone, and somber weapons go to +10 with a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Those final stones are limited. Nepheli’s throne reward and Latenna’s final reward are two sources.

steps.title: Meet Hewg at the Roundtable Hold
steps.hint: Speak to the blacksmith in the corridor and exhaust his first dialogue.

steps.title: Ask Hewg to train Roderika
steps.hint: Relay their dialogue until Hewg agrees. Reload the Hold to find Roderika at the other side of the corridor.

steps.title: Ask about the god-slaying weapon
steps.hint: Talk to Hewg after the Hold begins burning, before his memories fade.

steps.title: Strengthen a weapon to its maximum
steps.hint: Use an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone or a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone at Hewg’s anvil.

name: Finger Reader Enia
description: Speak to the Finger Reader about the Great Runes and trade boss Remembrances for their rewards.
warning: Exchanging or consuming a Remembrance spends that copy. Check both rewards before deciding. A compatible unused duplication site can copy a Remembrance you’ve already spent.

notes.label: Audience
notes.text: Claim a Great Rune and return to the newly opened chamber at Roundtable Hold. The first audience also advances Varré’s route.

notes.label: Duplication
notes.text: Walking Mausoleums with bells can duplicate shardbearer Remembrances. The bell-less mausoleums have a more limited selection.

notes.label: Late-game service
notes.text: Ask about the burning of the Erdtree before you advance if you want Enia’s dialogue. Remembrance exchange remains accessible after her death.

steps.title: Meet Enia after claiming a Great Rune
steps.hint: Obtain your first Great Rune to open the doors by the Hold’s central table, then speak to Enia before the Two Fingers.

steps.title: Hear the Two Fingers’ guidance
steps.hint: With two Great Runes, speak to Enia again about entering Leyndell.

steps.title: Ask Enia about burning the Erdtree
steps.hint: After defeating Morgott and seeing the sealed Erdtree, return to ask Enia about the Cardinal Sin.

name: Blackguard Big Boggart
description: Buy back Rya’s necklace, befriend Boggart, and decide when to visit him near Leyndell.
warning: If Boggart has moved to the outer moat before the Dung Eater’s invasion, the Dung Eater can kill him. Complete that invasion before moving Boggart there if you want to keep him alive.

notes.label: Opening the shop
notes.text: Accept Rya’s request and buy her necklace from Boggart for 1,000 runes before joining Volcano Manor. Buy Boiled Prawn to befriend him and enable his move to the moat.

notes.label: The Seedbed Curse
notes.text: His death in the Dung Eater’s route grants one of the possible Seedbed Curses. The Dung Eater needs five, and you can use other sources to spare Boggart.

steps.title: Buy Rya’s necklace
steps.hint: Ask Rya what happened, then pay Boggart 1,000 runes for her necklace at Boilprawn Shack.

steps.title: Buy boiled prawn
steps.hint: Buy at least one prawn and speak to Boggart so he is friendly and can relocate.

steps.title: Meet Boggart in Leyndell’s moat
steps.hint: Find him by the moat outside Leyndell and talk to him about his move. He now sells boiled crab.

steps.title: Hear Boggart’s warning about Dung Eater
steps.hint: If following Dung Eater’s route, exhaust Boggart’s warning before reloading. That route can cost Boggart his life.

name: Rya (Zorayas)
description: Help Rya reach Volcano Manor and decide what to do after she learns the truth about her birth.
warning: Investigate the manor and give Rya the Serpent’s Amnion before killing Rykard. Advancing too early can skip her hidden-room conversations and letter.

notes.label: Getting in
notes.text: Buy her necklace from Boggart and return it. Take Rya’s hand in Altus for a shortcut to the manor. You can also reach the manor by traveling there yourself.

notes.label: Amnion
notes.text: Explore the manor’s secret passage and defeat the Godskin Noble at the Temple of Eiglay. Take the Serpent’s Amnion from the altar and give it to Rya.

notes.label: Final choice
notes.text: Killing Rya yields Daedicar’s Woe and ends her story. Giving Tanith’s Tonic of Forgetfulness removes the letter outcome. Leave Rya alive and skip the tonic if you want Zorayas’s Letter. Return to her after Rykard and reload when instructed.

steps.title: Accept Rya’s request
steps.hint: Find Rya in the lakeside pavilion east of the Scenic Isle and offer to retrieve her necklace.

steps.title: Buy back Rya’s necklace
steps.hint: Ask Boggart for Rya’s necklace at Boilprawn Shack and pay 1,000 runes.

steps.title: Return the necklace to Rya
steps.hint: Take it to her pavilion to receive the Volcano Manor Invitation.

steps.title: Take Rya’s hand in Altus
steps.hint: Find Rya at the top of the Grand Lift of Dectus, or by Lux Ruins if you used the precipice. She takes you to Volcano Manor.

steps.title: Talk to Zorayas in her serpent form
steps.hint: Join Volcano Manor and do Tanith’s first contract. Speak to Rya in the drawing room, then find her in the neighboring room.

steps.title: Recover the Serpent’s Amnion
steps.hint: Find the hidden passage in the drawing rooms, defeat the Godskin Noble and search the altar in Temple of Eiglay.

steps.title: Give Rya the Serpent’s Amnion
steps.hint: Return to her manor room and tell her what you found. She will leave the drawing rooms.

steps.title: Resolve Rya’s fate
steps.hint: Find her in the hidden room off the lava route. To let her leave on her own, spare her, keep the tonic and return after defeating Rykard.

name: Hyetta
description: Guide Hyetta to the Three Fingers, where you can inherit the flame for the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.
warning: Taking the Frenzied Flame behind the door overrides the other endings until you remove it with Miquella’s Needle. Hyetta’s guidance and the decision to open the door are separate.

notes.label: Three Shabriri Grapes
notes.text: Collect the grape beyond Godrick in Stormveil, the one below Purified Ruins, and Edgar the Revenger’s drop at Revenger’s Shack. Irina and Edgar’s quest leads to that invasion.

notes.label: The truth and the fingerprint
notes.text: After Irina’s fate plays out, find Hyetta at Lake-Facing Cliffs. At Gate Town Bridge, tell Hyetta what the grapes really are, then reload and talk again. Defeat Festering Fingerprint Vyke near the Church of Inhibition for the Fingerprint Grape.

notes.label: Lord of Frenzied Flame ending
notes.text: Remove your armor at the Three Fingers’ door to open it and inherit the flame. You can enter independently of Hyetta’s quest. Finishing her scene can grant the Frenzied Flame Seal.

steps.title: Give Hyetta the first Shabriri Grape
steps.hint: Once she appears at Lake-Facing Cliffs, give her the grape found past Godrick’s throne room or another spare grape.

steps.title: Give Hyetta the second grape
steps.hint: Meet her at the western edge of Purified Ruins. Another grape is in the cellar under boards in the ruins.

steps.title: Give Hyetta the third grape
steps.hint: Speak to her at Gate Town Bridge. Edgar the Revenger can provide the third grape.

steps.title: Tell Hyetta about the grapes
steps.hint: Tell her the grapes are eyes, rest and talk again until she decides to become a Finger Maiden.

steps.title: Recover the Fingerprint Grape from Vyke
steps.hint: Head to the Church of Inhibition and beat Festering Fingerprint Vyke.

steps.title: Give Hyetta the Fingerprint Grape
steps.hint: Visit her again, this time by Bellum Church, and give her Vyke’s grape.

steps.title: Meet Hyetta below Leyndell
steps.hint: Defeat Mohg, the Omen, reveal the hidden path and descend to the Frenzied Flame Proscription.

steps.title: Touch Hyetta with the Frenzied Flame
steps.hint: If you choose this ending route, accept the Three Fingers without armor and return to Hyetta to claim the Frenzied Flame Seal.

name: Latenna & Old Albus
description: Escort Latenna to the Apostate Derelict and unlock access to the Consecrated Snowfield.
warning: Speak to Latenna with Albus’s half before collecting the Castle Sol half. Finding both first can leave her dead and cost you her final reward.

notes.label: Right and left halves
notes.text: Speak to Old Albus, disguised as a pot in the Village of the Albinaurics, for the right half. After recruiting Latenna at Slumbering Wolf’s Shack, get the left half beyond Commander Niall in Castle Sol.

notes.label: Final delivery
notes.text: Choose the secret medallion action at the Grand Lift of Rold. At Apostate Derelict use the special prompt beside the giant Albinauric to summon Latenna and receive a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.

steps.title: Receive Albus’s half of the secret medallion
steps.hint: Break the pot disguise in the Village of the Albinaurics and speak to Albus.

steps.title: Take Latenna with you
steps.hint: Clear Lakeside Crystal Cave and reach the shack beyond. Show her Albus’s half and agree to her request before obtaining the other half.

steps.title: Find the other half in Castle Sol
steps.hint: Defeat Commander Niall and take the left half from the rooftop beyond the boss.
steps.place: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Summon Latenna at the Apostate Derelict
steps.hint: Hoist the secret medallion at the Grand Lift of Rold, cross the Consecrated Snowfield, and use the summon prompt beside the giant Albinauric.
steps.place: Apostate Derelict · Mountaintops of the Giants

name: Jar-Bairn
description: Earn Jar-Bairn’s trust, see Jarburg’s aftermath, and give him the strength to leave on his own journey.
warning: Keep the friendly jars alive. Killing Alexander before his final duel costs you his Innards, which are required for Jar-Bairn’s final reward.

notes.label: Linked stories
notes.text: Exhaust Jar-Bairn’s dialogue and rest or reload between visits. Diallos’s quest adds his arrival and the defense of Jarburg.

notes.label: Required delivery
notes.text: Complete Alexander’s duel in Farum Azula and collect Alexander’s Innards. Give them to Jar-Bairn and reload to collect the Companion Jar talisman.

steps.title: Meet Jar-Bairn in Jarburg
steps.hint: Drop down the cliff ledges from Liurnia and speak to the little jar on the steps. Return after resting for new dialogue.

steps.title: Hear about the poachers
steps.hint: Reload and talk until Jar-Bairn tells you about the poachers. Advance Diallos until he moves to Jarburg.

steps.title: Return after the attack on Jarburg
steps.hint: When Diallos has settled in the village, revisit Jar-Bairn through rests or reloads until Diallos is found injured.

steps.title: Give Jar-Bairn Alexander’s Innards
steps.hint: After finishing Alexander’s quest, give Jar-Bairn the Innards and hear his farewell.

steps.title: Claim the Companion Jar talisman
steps.hint: Reload Jarburg and search the steps where Jar-Bairn used to sit.

name: War Counselor Iji
description: Follow Iji’s service to Ranni and his response to Blaidd’s fate.
warning: Leave Iji alive to hear his final conversation. Tell him about Blaidd’s death when you’re ready to trigger Iji’s last scene.

notes.label: Blaidd’s prison
notes.text: Ask Iji about Blaidd if you find him locked inside the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Freeing Blaidd is optional for Ranni’s route.

notes.label: Final return
notes.text: Finish Ranni’s route, defeat the hostile Blaidd at her tower, and report back to Iji. Reload for Iji’s Mirrorhelm and Bell Bearing.

steps.title: Meet Iji on the road to the manor
steps.hint: Speak to Iji beside the Road to the Manor grace. Mention Blaidd if you have met him.

steps.title: Speak to Iji in Ranni’s service
steps.hint: After Ranni accepts you, talk to Iji’s projection in her tower.

steps.title: Ask Iji why Blaidd is imprisoned
steps.hint: After Radahn, visit the Forlorn Hound Evergaol and then ask Iji about it.

steps.title: Tell Iji about Blaidd’s death
steps.hint: After facing Blaidd outside Ranni’s Rise, return to Iji and pick the dialogue about Blaidd’s death.

steps.title: Retrieve Iji’s Mirrorhelm
steps.hint: Reload the area after that conversation and collect the helm and bell bearing from Iji’s spot.

name: Preceptor Seluvis
description: Decide what to do with Seluvis’s Potion and follow his puppet scheme for the Magic Scorpion Charm.
warning: Earn the Magic Scorpion Charm before giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. The blade handover ends Seluvis’s scheme and makes the charm missable.

notes.label: Potion recipients
notes.text: Giving the potion to Nepheli cuts off her throne route. Giving it to the imprisoned Dung Eater after his invasion cuts off the Blessing of Despair ending and unlocks his puppet for purchase. Let Gideon dispose of it to preserve both questlines.

notes.label: Puppets and starlight
notes.text: Investigate the hidden cellar, confront Seluvis, and follow his puppet dialogue. Keep Starlight Shards for puppet purchases. Find Amber Starlight in Altus by the statue northeast of Altus Highway Junction and bring it to him for the charm.

notes.label: Amber Draught
notes.text: Taking the draught is enough to see the last stage of his scheme. Giving it to Ranni makes her hostile. Use Celestial Dew at the Church of Vows if you need to regain her cooperation.

steps.title: Accept Seluvis’s potion
steps.hint: Enter Ranni’s service, then visit Seluvis at his own tower and agree to take the potion.

steps.title: Resolve the potion request
steps.hint: Gideon can dispose of the potion to protect Nepheli. Giving it to Nepheli or Dung Eater has permanent consequences for their routes.

steps.title: Investigate the puppet cellar
steps.hint: Reveal the hidden stairs among the Three Sisters ruins and read the message near the puppets.

steps.title: Hear Seluvis’s scheme
steps.hint: Return to Seluvis, choose and buy a puppet, then agree to help with his scheme before delivering Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade.

steps.title: Find Amber Starlight
steps.hint: Look beneath the statue inside the Altus alcove northeast of Altus Highway Junction.

steps.title: Collect the Magic Scorpion Charm
steps.hint: Give the Amber Starlight to Seluvis and collect the talisman before handing the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni.

steps.title: Receive the Amber Draught
steps.hint: Give Seluvis the Amber Starlight, then return for the draught. Offering it to Ranni angers her and can require absolution.

steps.title: Offer the draught to Ranni
steps.hint: An optional outcome that interrupts Ranni’s quest. Use the Church of Vows for absolution if you want to continue serving her.

name: Pidia, Carian Servant
description: Find the hidden merchant in Caria Manor and recover the puppet left after Seluvis’s scheme ends.
warning: Choose the recipient for Seluvis’s potion before handing Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Your choice determines which puppet Pidia leaves.

notes.label: Finding Pidia
notes.text: After reaching Three Sisters, drop down the cliffs onto the manor roof and use the ladder to reach the balcony above Manor Lower Level.

notes.label: Puppet branch
notes.text: After the Fingerslayer Blade handover, return for Pidia’s Bell Bearing and puppet. If Nepheli received Seluvis’s Potion, the drop is the Nepheli Loux Puppet. The usual drop is Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet.

steps.title: Find Pidia above the Manor Lower Level
steps.hint: From the Three Sisters side of Caria Manor, descend the wooden ledges to the balcony where Pidia sells his goods.

steps.title: Return after Seluvis’s death
steps.hint: After Ranni receives the Fingerslayer Blade, repeat the descent and pick up the puppet and bell bearing at Pidia’s spot.

name: Miriel, Pastor of Vows
description: Ask Miriel about Radagon and Rennala, and give him scrolls or prayerbooks to learn their spells.
warning: Leave Miriel alive to keep his teaching and dialogue available. Celestial Dew can resolve hostility toward living NPCs. An NPC you killed generally stays dead.

notes.label: Scrolls and prayerbooks
notes.text: Miriel accepts both types. The Golden Order Principia from Leyndell unlocks Law of Regression, which is needed for Goldmask’s route to the Age of Order ending.

notes.label: Church of Vows
notes.text: Bring a Celestial Dew to the statue for absolution if you have angered an NPC and the game offers the option.

steps.title: Meet Miriel at the Church of Vows
steps.hint: Speak to him until his shop and conversation options open.

steps.title: Hear the history of Radagon and Rennala
steps.hint: Ask Miriel about both Radagon and Rennala to learn the history of the church.

steps.title: Give Miriel a scroll or prayerbook
steps.hint: Optionally hand over a book or scroll to learn its spells. Miriel accepts both types.

name: Gurranq, Beast Clergyman
description: Collect nine Deathroots for Gurranq and claim the final Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
warning: Gurranq’s attack after the fourth Deathroot is scripted. Damage him until he surrenders, then stop attacking and return to his dialogue.

notes.label: Finding the Sanctum
notes.text: Show D a Deathroot to learn about the waygate near the Third Church of Marika. You can also travel to the Bestial Sanctum yourself.

notes.label: Finding all nine
notes.text: The journal maps each Deathroot. Check boss rewards from Tibia Mariners and chests in the listed catacombs or hidden paths.

notes.label: After Maliketh
notes.text: Gurranq’s Deathroot hand-ins at the Bestial Sanctum remain available after Maliketh is defeated in Farum Azula.

steps.title: Deliver the first Deathroot
steps.hint: Enter the Bestial Sanctum from Dragonbarrow or D’s waygate. Trade a Deathroot for the Clawmark Seal and Beast Eye.

steps.title: Soothe Gurranq after the fourth Deathroot
steps.hint: After four deliveries he attacks on a return visit. Damage him until he yields, then stop, rest and speak to him.

steps.title: Deliver all nine Deathroots
steps.hint: Finish the trades for the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Deathroots come from Tibia Mariners and dungeon chests.

steps.title: Find Deathroot at Summonwater Village
steps.hint: Defeat the Tibia Mariner at Summonwater Village in Limgrave.

steps.title: Find Deathroot in Deathtouched Catacombs
steps.hint: Defeat the Black Knife Assassin and open the chest by the arena exit.

steps.title: Find Deathroot in Black Knife Catacombs
steps.hint: Defeat the Cemetery Shade and check the treasure chest behind it.

steps.title: Find Deathroot by the Artist’s Shack
steps.hint: Defeat the Tibia Mariner in eastern Liurnia.

steps.title: Find Deathroot by Wyndham Ruins
steps.hint: Defeat the Tibia Mariner in the ruins west of Altus Plateau.

steps.title: Find Deathroot in Gelmir Hero’s Grave
steps.hint: Defeat the Red Wolf of the Champion and check the boss room chest.

steps.title: Find Deathroot in Giants’ Mountaintop Catacombs
steps.hint: Defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit and open the boss room chest.

steps.title: Find Deathroot near Castle Sol
steps.hint: Defeat the Tibia Mariner on the ridge above Castle Sol.

steps.title: Find Deathroot on the Hidden Path
steps.hint: In the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, use the invisible bridge to reach the Stray Mimic Tear and its reward chest.

name: Gowry
description: Have Gowry repair the needle for Millicent, then follow his interest in how her quest ends.
warning: Gowry urges you to betray Millicent. Use the gold sign to help her if you want to recover the needle for Miquella’s Needle.

notes.label: Needle repair
notes.text: Defeat Commander O’Neil in the Swamp of Aeonia to get the Unalloyed Gold Needle. Give it to Gowry, reload, then take the repaired needle to Millicent at the Church of the Plague.

notes.label: Shop changes
notes.text: After you give Millicent the Valkyrie’s Prosthesis, revisit Gowry for Pest Threads. The prosthesis is in the Shaded Castle.

notes.label: After Millicent’s choice
notes.text: Challenging Millicent can leave Gowry’s Bell Bearing and Flock’s Canvas Talisman in his shack. If you aided her, you can collect those rewards by killing Gowry after her story ends.

steps.title: Hear Gowry’s request
steps.hint: Speak to him in the shack south of Sellia and agree to help Millicent.

steps.title: Recover the needle from Commander O’Neil
steps.hint: Defeat the commander in the Heart of Aeonia to take the broken needle.

steps.title: Have Gowry repair the needle
steps.hint: Hand over the needle, then rest or reload and return to collect it.

steps.title: Return after Millicent’s recovery
steps.hint: Give Millicent the repaired needle and speak to her at the shack. Return again to unlock Gowry’s shop.

steps.title: Discuss Millicent’s new arm
steps.hint: After the prosthesis, tell Gowry about it. Pest Threads and more dialogue become available.

steps.title: Speak with Gowry after Millicent’s choice
steps.hint: Return to the shack after resolving Millicent’s fate at the Haligtree and follow his final dialogue.

name: Millicent
description: Help Millicent recover and choose between two final branches in Elphael. One branch can free you from the Frenzied Flame.
warning: Aiding and challenging Millicent give different rewards. Use the gold sign to preserve the needle route if you might need to undo the Frenzied Flame.

notes.label: Cross-quest items
notes.text: Get the Unalloyed Gold Needle from Commander O’Neil, have it repaired by Gowry, and give it to Millicent. Later collect the Valkyrie’s Prosthesis at the Shaded Castle and give it to her near Erdtree-Gazing Hill.

notes.label: Gold sign
notes.text: Defend Millicent against her sisters after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit. This earns the Rotten Winged Sword Insignia. Speak to Millicent afterward and return for the Unalloyed Gold Needle.

notes.label: Red sign
notes.text: Challenge Millicent for Millicent’s Prosthesis. This choice ends the needle route for this journey.

notes.label: Removing the flame
notes.text: After defeating Malenia, use the recovered needle on her bloom for Miquella’s Needle. Use it inside Dragonlord Placidusax’s arena in Farum Azula to remove the flame. This permanently gives up the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending for this journey.

giver.hint: Gowry starts Millicent’s route at his shack south of Sellia.

steps.title: Agree to help Gowry
steps.hint: Speak to Gowry in his shack and hear his request to help Millicent.

steps.title: Get the Unalloyed Gold Needle
steps.hint: Defeat Commander O’Neil in Aeonia, then bring it to Gowry and return after resting for the repair.

steps.title: Give Millicent the repaired needle
steps.hint: Reach the Church of the Plague and give her the needle. Rest and talk again to get her reward.

steps.title: Speak to Millicent at Gowry’s shack
steps.hint: Return to the shack after Millicent recovers and speak to her while Gowry is away.

steps.title: Take the Valkyrie’s Prosthesis
steps.hint: Reach the chest guarded by a Cleanrot Knight in the Shaded Castle.

steps.title: Give Millicent the prosthesis in Altus
steps.hint: Find her north of Erdtree-Gazing Hill and hand over the prosthesis.

steps.title: Meet Millicent at Windmill Heights
steps.hint: Defeat the Godskin Apostle in Dominula, rest and talk to her at the grace.

steps.title: Speak to Millicent at Ancient Snow Valley Ruins
steps.hint: Follow the Mountaintops route until you reach the valley grace and exhaust her dialogue.
steps.place: Millicent (5th Location) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Speak to Millicent in Elphael
steps.hint: Find her beside the Prayer Room grace after journeying through the Haligtree.
steps.place: Millicent (6th Location) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Defeat the Ulcerated Tree Spirit
steps.hint: Cross to the pool of rot near Drainage Channel and defeat the spirit to reveal the summon signs.
steps.place: Ulcerated Tree Spirit · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Choose whether to aid or challenge Millicent
steps.hint: Use the gold sign to help against her sisters, then talk to her and reload to recover the needle.
steps.place: Assisting Millicent / Challenging Millicent · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Or challenge Millicent
steps.hint: The red sign leads to the alternate duel and prevents the needle route. Choose one of the two signs.
steps.place: Assisting Millicent / Challenging Millicent · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Use the needle on Malenia’s bloom
steps.hint: After helping Millicent and defeating Malenia, take the recovered needle to the bloom for Miquella’s Needle.
steps.place: Malenia, Blade of Miquella · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Remove the Frenzied Flame
steps.hint: If you carry the Frenzied Flame, optionally use Miquella’s Needle in Placidusax’s arena to restore access to other endings.

name: Witch-Hunter Jerren
description: Help Jerren finish the Radahn Festival and follow his hunt for Sellen.
warning: Choosing a side outside Raya Lucaria’s Grand Library determines who survives. Decide which reward you want before using a summon sign.

notes.label: After Radahn
notes.text: Exhaust Jerren’s dialogue in Redmane Castle after the fight. Progress Sellen’s Primal Glintstone route to see Jerren’s scene at Witchbane Ruins.

notes.label: Choose Jerren
notes.text: Use the red sign to challenge Sellen. This yields an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from Jerren.

notes.label: Choose Sellen
notes.text: Use the gold sign to assist Sellen and defeat Jerren. This path yields the Glintstone Kris and access to Shard Spiral through Sellen.

steps.title: Join Jerren’s Radahn Festival
steps.hint: When the festival is active, speak to its announcer overlooking Redmane Castle plaza and say you are ready.

steps.title: Defeat Starscourge Radahn
steps.hint: Take the portal beyond the chapel to the Wailing Dunes and beat Radahn.

steps.title: Speak to Jerren after the festival
steps.hint: Return to the chapel at Redmane Castle and hear him out before he leaves.

steps.title: Find Jerren at Witchbane Ruins
steps.hint: After obtaining Sellen’s Primal Glintstone, reload the ruins and speak to Jerren by her old body.

steps.title: Resolve Jerren’s conflict with Sellen
steps.hint: Use Jerren’s red sign to aid him, or Sellen’s gold sign to oppose him. If you aid him, speak with him for his reward.

name: Tanith & Volcano Manor
description: Join Volcano Manor, complete its contracts, and decide how to resolve Tanith’s final scene after Rykard.
warning: Finish the manor contracts and collect their rewards before killing Rykard. His death can end the assignments for Tanith, Patches, and Bernahl.

notes.label: Joining the manor
notes.text: Joining grants the Drawing-Room Key and access to the contracts. This choice does not choose an ending.

notes.label: Contracts
notes.text: Complete Old Knight Istvan, Rileigh the Idle, and Juno Hoslow, reporting back for their rewards. The last target is in the Mountaintops. Check with Patches and Bernahl while the manor is active.

notes.label: After Rykard
notes.text: If you want to offer Patches’ Dancer’s Castanets, do so before killing Tanith in Rykard’s arena. Killing her there triggers her Crucible Knight encounter.

steps.title: Join Volcano Manor
steps.hint: Speak to Tanith and agree to join. Use the Drawing-Room Key to claim the first letter.

steps.title: Carry out the first contract
steps.hint: Use the red sign for Old Knight Istvan in Limgrave, defeat him, and return to Tanith for Magma Shot.

steps.title: Carry out the second contract
steps.hint: Find Rileigh’s red sign in the Altus ravine and return to Tanith after the duel.

steps.title: Carry out the final contract
steps.hint: After reaching the Mountaintops, defeat Juno Hoslow near Shack of the Lofty. Report back for Taker’s Cameo.
steps.place: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Defeat Rykard
steps.hint: After the contracts, accept Tanith’s audience or reach Rykard by the dungeon route. Killing him ends outstanding Manor contracts.
steps.place: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Speak to Tanith after Rykard dies
steps.hint: Hear her farewell at Volcano Manor and reload the area.

steps.title: Find Tanith in Rykard’s arena
steps.hint: Return to the arena and talk to her beside Rykard’s remains.

steps.title: Face Tanith’s Crucible Knight
steps.hint: An optional hostile outcome. If you attack Tanith, defeat her bodyguard to obtain Aspects of the Crucible: Breath.

name: Knight Bernahl
description: Follow Bernahl from Warmaster’s Shack through the manor’s contracts and to his invasion in Farum Azula.
warning: Do Bernahl’s Leyndell assignment and collect the reward before killing Rykard or Maliketh. Rykard ends the contracts, and Maliketh changes the capital.

notes.label: Getting the letter
notes.text: Join Tanith’s manor and finish its first two contracts. Ask Bernahl in the drawing room for his letter, then use his red sign in Leyndell to help fight Vargram and Wilhelm.

notes.label: Turning in
notes.text: Return to Bernahl after the fight for Gelmir’s Fury. Keep him alive to see his later invasion and earn the Blasphemous Claw.

steps.title: Meet Bernahl at Warmaster’s Shack
steps.hint: Speak to Bernahl during daylight and open his Ash of War shop.

steps.title: Talk to Bernahl at Volcano Manor
steps.hint: Join Tanith and speak to Bernahl in the drawing room. Return after Tanith’s second contract for his letter.

steps.title: Help Bernahl invade Vargram and Wilhelm
steps.hint: Before killing Rykard, use the red sign inside Fortified Manor in Leyndell and defeat both targets.
steps.place: Vargram, the Raging Wolf · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Report back to Bernahl
steps.hint: Return to Volcano Manor to collect Gelmir’s Fury for completing Bernahl’s contract.

steps.title: Defeat Recusant Bernahl in Farum Azula
steps.hint: After Rykard, go down the path opposite Maliketh’s approach and defeat Bernahl’s invasion.

name: Primeval Sorcerers Azur & Lusat
description: Learn Comet Azur, open Lusat’s sealed prison, and recover the primeval sorcerers’ robes through Sellen.
warning: Side with Sellen outside the Grand Library if you want Azur’s and Lusat’s sets. Helping Jerren trades away that reward route.

notes.label: Sealbreaker
notes.text: Speak to Azur past Hermit Village on Mt. Gelmir. Show Comet Azur to Sellen, accept her request, and take the Sellian Sealbreaker to the barrier in Sellia Hideaway.

notes.label: Recovering the robes
notes.text: After Sellen’s finale on her side, revisit Azur’s and Lusat’s locations for their armor.

steps.title: Meet Azur beyond Hermit Village
steps.hint: Reach the far end of the village and speak to Azur for Comet Azur.

steps.title: Get Sellen’s Sealbreaker
steps.hint: Show her Azur’s sorcery and agree to find Master Lusat.

steps.title: Meet Lusat in Sellia Hideaway
steps.hint: Open the seal beneath Sellia Hideaway and approach Lusat for Stars of Ruin.

steps.title: Return for Azur’s robes
steps.hint: Aid Sellen at the Grand Library, tell her where Lusat is and reload. Return to Azur’s body for his set.

steps.title: Return for Lusat’s robes
steps.hint: After aiding Sellen and returning to his chamber, look where you found Lusat for his set.
