name: Shabriri
description: Meet Shabriri at Zamor Ruins and decide whether to inherit the flame beneath Leyndell for the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending.
warning: The Three Fingers’ flame forces the Lord of Frenzied Flame ending while active. Taking it before the Forge makes Melina leave. You need Miquella’s Needle to undo it.

notes.label: Finding the door
notes.text: Defeat Mohg, the Omen beneath Leyndell, then descend to the Frenzied Flame Proscription. Remove your armor at the door to receive the flame.

notes.label: Ronin’s Set
notes.text: After taking the flame, return to where Shabriri stood to collect his armor. Killing Shabriri also drops the set. The Three Fingers remain accessible.

notes.label: Reversing the decision
notes.text: Aid Millicent, recover her needle, and exchange it at Malenia’s bloom. Use Miquella’s Needle in Placidusax’s arena. You cannot reclaim the flame after doing so in the same journey.

giver.place: Yura (Zamor Ruins) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Hear Shabriri out at Zamor Ruins
steps.hint: Speak to the man in Yura’s body near the first Mountaintops grace. He points to the Three Fingers below Leyndell.
steps.place: Yura (Zamor Ruins) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Choose whether to inherit the Frenzied Flame
steps.hint: If you want this route, reach the Proscription below Leyndell, remove your armor and open the Three Fingers’ door.

steps.title: Return for the Ronin’s Set
steps.hint: After inheriting the flame, return to where Shabriri stood and collect the armor he leaves behind.
steps.place: Yura (Zamor Ruins) · Mountaintops of the Giants

name: The Great-Jar
description: Reach the Caelid colosseum overlook and survive the Great-Jar’s challenge for an equip-load talisman.
warning: Defeat all three duelists on the same attempt. Dying before finishing the set resets the challenge.

notes.label: Getting there
notes.text: Bring two Stonesword Keys to unlock the lift at the far end of Siofra River. Ride it to Deep Siofra Well and follow the canyon to the Great-Jar.

notes.label: Duel signs
notes.text: Speak to the jar and use the three red summon signs one at a time. Talk to the Great-Jar after all three wins to receive Great-Jar’s Arsenal.

steps.title: Speak to the Great-Jar
steps.hint: Use the Siofra River Deep Well lift to reach the Dragonbarrow ravine. Talk to the giant jar beside the colosseum.

steps.title: Defeat the Great-Jar’s three knights
steps.hint: Use all three red signs and win each duel without dying or resting between them. Speak to the Great-Jar again for the Arsenal talisman.

name: Aureliette & Aurelia
description: Reunite the jellyfish sisters at Stargazers’ Ruins to open the sealed cellar.
warning: Bring the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes obtained from Roderika. The seal opens when you summon those ashes beside Aureliette.

notes.label: Getting the ashes
notes.text: Speak with Roderika about the spirits at Stormhill Shack or Roundtable Hold. Keep the ashes for your visit to Stargazers’ Ruins in the Mountaintops.

notes.label: Reward
notes.text: Summon the Spirit Jellyfish near the talking jellyfish, wait for the reunion, and take the Primal Glintstone Blade from the cellar.

giver.place: Aureliette (Spirit Jellyfish) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Obtain the Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
steps.hint: Ask Roderika about her companions at Stormhill Shack, or speak to her at the Roundtable Hold if she has moved.

steps.title: Reunite the jellyfish sisters
steps.hint: Answer the jellyfish’s call in the ruins by summoning your Spirit Jellyfish Ashes beside her.
steps.place: Aureliette (Spirit Jellyfish) · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Open the unsealed cellar
steps.hint: After the sisters disappear, open the chest in the ruins to get the Primal Glintstone Blade talisman.
steps.place: Primal Glintstone Blade · Mountaintops of the Giants

name: The Elden Throne
description: Defeat the final bosses and choose an ending your journey has unlocked. The Age of Fracture ending is the default. The other endings are Age of Order, Age of the Duskborn, Blessing of Despair, Age of the Stars, and Lord of Frenzied Flame.
warning: Defeating Maliketh turns Leyndell into the Ashen Capital. Finish Goldmask’s Royal Capital puzzle and any Royal Capital contracts or pickups you want first. Once you select an ending, that journey’s choice is final.

notes.label: Opening Leyndell
notes.text: The usual entrance requires two Great Runes and an audience with the Two Fingers at Roundtable Hold. Godrick is one possible rune holder.

notes.label: Before the Forge
notes.text: Hear the Roundtable Hold conversations you want before agreeing to light the Forge. The Forge advances the story to Farum Azula, and Maliketh’s defeat later changes Leyndell.

notes.label: Choosing an ending
notes.text: Defeating the final boss leaves the ending choice open. You can leave from the grace and return after finishing side quests. An active Frenzied Flame restricts the choice to its ending until you remove it.

notes.label: Age of Fracture ending
notes.text: Select Mend the Elden Ring at Fractured Marika without using a special mending rune.

notes.label: Age of Order ending
notes.text: Complete Corhyn and Goldmask’s route and use the Mending Rune of Perfect Order at Fractured Marika.

notes.label: Age of the Duskborn ending
notes.text: Complete Fia’s route and use the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince at Fractured Marika.

notes.label: Blessing of Despair ending
notes.text: Feed the Dung Eater five Seedbed Curses, then use the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse at Fractured Marika.

notes.label: Age of the Stars ending
notes.text: Complete Ranni’s route and use her blue summon sign after the final boss.

notes.label: Lord of Frenzied Flame ending
notes.text: Inherit the flame from the Three Fingers and keep it through the final interaction. Millicent’s aid branch can provide Miquella’s Needle to remove it.

giver.hint: Enia gives the Two Fingers’ guidance at Roundtable Hold.

steps.title: Claim Godrick’s Great Rune
steps.hint: Reach Stormveil Castle and defeat Godrick. A different shardbearer can supply the first Great Rune if you bypass Stormveil.

steps.title: Seek an audience with the Two Fingers
steps.hint: After claiming a Great Rune, return to the room by the main table in Roundtable Hold and speak with Enia.

steps.title: Reach the Erdtree and defeat Morgott
steps.hint: Enter Leyndell and face Morgott at the Elden Throne. The Erdtree’s thorns will still bar the entrance.
steps.place: Morgott, the Omen King · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Receive the Rold Medallion
steps.hint: Examine the thorns, then rest at Elden Throne and accept Melina’s medallion.

steps.title: Defeat the Fire Giant
steps.hint: Cross the Mountaintops and defeat the giant who guards the Forge.
steps.place: Fire Giant · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Light the Forge
steps.hint: Rest at the Forge of the Giants and choose the prompt to proceed. This opens the path to Farum Azula.
steps.place: Forge of The Giants · Mountaintops of the Giants

steps.title: Defeat Maliketh
steps.hint: Follow the paths of Farum Azula to Maliketh and release Destined Death.
steps.place: Maliketh, the Black Blade · Crumbling Farum Azula

steps.title: Defeat Gideon Ofnir
steps.hint: Find Gideon in the former Erdtree Sanctuary after the capital turns to Ash.
steps.place: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing · Altus Plateau

steps.title: Defeat Hoarah Loux
steps.hint: Return to the Elden Throne and defeat the first Elden Lord.

steps.title: Defeat Radagon and the Elden Beast
steps.hint: Enter the Erdtree and win the final battle.

steps.title: Choose an ending
steps.hint: Use Fractured Marika or an available alternate ending prompt. The quest records the choice once the ending is saved.

name: Shadow of the Erdtree
description: Follow Miquella through the Realm of Shadow and open the path to the divine gate.
warning: Finish the followers’ side quests before using Messmer’s Kindling at the Sealing Tree. First Rise is used as save evidence that Enir-Ilim has opened.

notes.label: Enter the realm
notes.text: Defeat Starscourge Radahn and Mohg, Lord of Blood, and touch the withered arm in Mohgwyn Palace.

notes.label: Crossing to Scadu Altus
notes.text: Castle Ensis is the main route. The spiritspring near the Fort of Reprimand offers another entrance.

steps.title: Enter the Realm of Shadow
steps.hint: Touch the withered arm in Mohgwyn Palace, then rest at Gravesite Plain.

steps.title: Reach Scadu Altus
steps.hint: Pass through Castle Ensis and defeat Rellana, or reach Highroad Cross by the eastern route.

steps.title: Defeat Messmer the Impaler
steps.hint: Reach the upper Specimen Storehouse for Messmer’s Kindling.

steps.title: Defeat Romina, Saint of the Bud
steps.hint: Cross the Ancient Ruins of Rauh to the Church of the Bud.
steps.place: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance · Ancient Ruins of Rauh

steps.title: Open Enir-Ilim
steps.hint: Finish time-sensitive side quests, burn the Sealing Tree with Messmer’s Kindling, then rest at First Rise.

steps.title: Pass Needle Knight Leda’s challenge
steps.hint: Use the signs in the next room to face Leda and her allies. Mark this after winning.

steps.title: Defeat Promised Consort Radahn
steps.hint: Climb the final staircase. The boss defeat is read from your save.

name: Sir Ansbach
description: Help Ansbach uncover Miquella’s plans and secure his aid in Enir-Ilim.
warning: Speak to Freyja on the seventh floor and tell Ansbach about her before handing over the Secret Rite Scroll. Siding against Ansbach ends his route.

notes.label: Leda’s challenge
notes.text: If Leda targets Ansbach, use his gold sign to protect him. The duel encounter depends on earlier choices and may be unavailable.

notes.label: Rewards
notes.text: Finish his preparations before burning the tree. Obsidian Lamina and Furious Blade of Ansbach can be collected after the final boss.

steps.title: Meet Ansbach at Belurat
steps.hint: Speak to Ansbach beside Moore at Main Gate Cross.

steps.title: Discuss Freyja with Ansbach
steps.hint: Speak to Freyja on the seventh floor, then tell Ansbach what she is looking for.

steps.title: Find the Secret Rite Scroll
steps.hint: Take the outer stairs below the upper balcony to the chamber with the scroll.

steps.title: Give the scroll to Ansbach
steps.hint: After telling him about Freyja, give him the scroll. Rest or reload, then ask for the letter and deliver it.

steps.title: Collect Ansbach’s final rewards
steps.hint: When his route is complete, check the arena after the final boss for his equipment and incantation.

name: Redmane Freyja
description: Help Freyja learn what happened between Radahn and Miquella.
warning: Talk to her in the Storehouse before you hand Ansbach the Secret Rite Scroll, or you can miss the Letter for Freyja.

notes.label: Letter delivery
notes.text: Once Ansbach gives you the letter, deliver it to Freyja and exhaust her dialogue to receive the Golden Lion Shield.

steps.title: Meet Freyja at the crossroads
steps.hint: Speak to her beside Hornsent and the cross.

steps.title: Learn what Freyja is researching
steps.hint: Speak to her by the grace, then raise the issue with Ansbach below.

steps.title: Deliver the Letter for Freyja
steps.hint: Take Ansbach’s letter back to Freyja and claim the Golden Lion Shield.

name: Needle Knight Leda
description: Follow Leda’s investigation as Miquella’s charm wears off.
warning: Her invasions have mutually exclusive rewards. Resolve any duel you want before advancing the story beyond the relevant NPC.

notes.label: Hornsent choice
notes.text: Help Hornsent at the Shadow Keep rampart for Swift Slash, or help Leda to obtain the Lacerating Crossed-Tree from her.

notes.label: Ansbach choice
notes.text: If Leda targets him, choose a side in the Storehouse. Killing Ansbach removes his finale route.

steps.title: Speak to Leda at Highroad Cross
steps.hint: Leda moves here after you enter the DLC. Revisit her after the charm breaks.

steps.title: Resolve the Hornsent duel
steps.hint: Check the red and gold signs near the rampart route by the burning boats.

steps.title: Check for the Ansbach duel
steps.hint: If the duel appears, decide whom to support. You can skip marking this if the signs never appear.

steps.title: Collect Leda’s Sword
steps.hint: Defeat Leda’s group and check the bodies beyond the room.

name: Hornsent
description: Follow Hornsent’s revenge from the crosses to Shadow Keep and Rauh.
warning: Siding with Leda against Hornsent closes his revenge route. If you want his Messmer dialogue, summon him from inside the arena.

notes.label: After Messmer
notes.text: Speak to Hornsent in the boss room if he survives his route. He may later invade near the Church of the Bud.

steps.title: Speak to Hornsent at Three-Path Cross
steps.hint: Get his map of the first crosses and talk again at Highroad Cross.

steps.title: Help Hornsent against Leda
steps.hint: When the signs appear by the burning boats, use the gold sign if you want Swift Slash.

steps.title: Let Hornsent confront Messmer
steps.hint: Look for his sign inside the boss room if available. Speak to him after the kill.

steps.title: Resolve Hornsent’s final encounter
steps.hint: If he invades on the approach, defeat him and collect his gear. Mark this if you already resolved his route on Leda’s side.
steps.place: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance · Ancient Ruins of Rauh

name: Hornsent Grandam
region: Realm of Shadow · Belurat, Tower Settlement
description: Win the Grandam’s trust in Belurat and earn her rewards.
warning: Start her early and finish the Divine Beast Head conversation before advancing the Shadow Keep storyline.

notes.label: Finding the room
notes.text: Find the Storeroom Key upstairs from the sewer route. The door is across the bridge beside Small Private Altar.

giver.place: Small Private Altar · Belurat, Tower Settlement

steps.title: Open the Storeroom and meet Grandam
steps.hint: Unlock the Storeroom and speak to Grandam inside.
steps.place: Small Private Altar · Belurat, Tower Settlement

steps.title: Defeat the Divine Beast Dancing Lion
steps.hint: Collect the Divine Beast Head from the fight.
steps.place: Theatre of the Divine Beast · Belurat, Tower Settlement

steps.title: Wear the Divine Beast Head for Grandam
steps.hint: Return in the headpiece, exhaust her dialogue and check back for stew after resting.
steps.place: Small Private Altar · Belurat, Tower Settlement

name: Moore
description: Trade with Moore, help the Forager Brood and make his dialogue choice after the charm breaks.
warning: Give Thiollier the Black Syrup before choosing Moore’s fate. Attack a Forager Brood and you risk losing access to their cookbooks.

notes.label: Advice to Moore
notes.text: Telling him to put it behind him can put him on Leda’s side. Telling him to remain sad leads to a different outcome. Leave him undecided while finishing the cookbooks.

steps.title: Meet Moore at Main Gate Cross
steps.hint: Speak to Moore. Visit Thiollier as well to open the Black Syrup conversation.

steps.title: Collect the Black Syrup
steps.hint: Ask Moore about Thiollier after meeting him at Pillar Path Cross.

steps.title: Give the syrup to Thiollier
steps.hint: Hand over the syrup to unlock Thiollier’s Concoction.

steps.title: Resolve Moore’s choice
steps.hint: Collect any missing cookbooks first, then choose how to answer him.

name: Thiollier
description: Help Thiollier reach St. Trina and learn how to secure his aid for the finale.
warning: Finish the St. Trina conversations and settle Thiollier’s challenge before burning the Sealing Tree if you want him available for the finale.

notes.label: Poison shop
notes.text: If you want Thiollier’s Concoction for the Dragon Communion Priestess, get it after delivering Moore’s syrup and before Thiollier relocates.

steps.title: Meet Thiollier
steps.hint: Speak to him at Pillar Path Cross and visit Moore if you want the syrup and concoction.

steps.title: Defeat the Putrescent Knight
steps.hint: Descend the Stone Coffin Fissure after the seal opens and jump into the arena.

steps.title: Relay St. Trina’s words
steps.hint: Imbibe repeatedly to hear St. Trina. Tell Thiollier what he said he could not hear, then win the invasion and speak again.
steps.place: Garden of Deep Purple · Stone Coffin Fissure

steps.title: Collect Thiollier’s final rewards
steps.hint: Finish his Fissure route before the finale and check the arena after the final boss.

name: St. Trina
region: Realm of Shadow · Stone Coffin Fissure
description: Find St. Trina hidden below the Cerulean Coast.
warning: Reveal each nectar step only when you are ready for the consequences. Finish the conversations before advancing the finale.

notes.label: Nectar
notes.text: Imbibing kills your character. Rest nearby and spend or recover runes before repeating it.

giver.place: Garden of Deep Purple · Stone Coffin Fissure

steps.title: Open the way to St. Trina
steps.hint: Pass the broken seal at the Fissure and defeat the Putrescent Knight.

steps.title: Hear St. Trina’s request
steps.hint: Imbibe four times to hear her first words. Return and repeat to hear the remaining lines.
steps.place: Garden of Deep Purple · Stone Coffin Fissure

steps.title: Return after the final boss
steps.hint: Once the final boss is defeated, revisit the garden for St. Trina’s Blossom.
steps.place: Garden of Deep Purple · Stone Coffin Fissure

name: Dryleaf Dane
description: Challenge the silent monk and learn his hand-to-hand style.
warning: Challenge Dane at Moorth Ruins while the field encounter is available. His Enir-Ilim appearance is a separate encounter.

notes.label: Challenge
notes.text: Pick up Monk’s Missive and the May the Best Win gesture at Highroad Cross. Use the gesture in front of Dane.

steps.title: Collect Dane’s invitation
steps.hint: Pick up the Monk’s Missive and its gesture beside the grace.

steps.title: Challenge Dane and learn Dryleaf Arts
steps.hint: Use May the Best Win in front of Dane and defeat him in the duel.

name: Count Ymir
description: Follow Ymir’s maps to the three hanging bells and discover what lies under his cathedral.
warning: Complete Ymir’s encounter before choosing Jolán’s iris reward. The Sword of Night and Jolán’s Spirit Ash are separate outcomes.

notes.label: Third bell
notes.text: Return to the cathedral and interact with the throne when Ymir is absent. Descend, defeat the invader, and ring the bell to face Metyr.

giver.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

steps.title: Speak with Count Ymir
steps.hint: Collect the Hole-Laden Necklace and his first map.
steps.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

steps.title: Ring the bell at Rhia
steps.hint: Reach Rhia from Cerulean Coast, ring the bell, then return to Ymir.
steps.place: Finger Ruins of Rhia · Cerulean Coast

steps.title: Ring the bell at Dheo
steps.hint: Use the O Mother gesture at Shadow Keep’s Back Gate statue to enter the Hinterland. Continue to the ruins and sound the bell.

steps.title: Defeat Metyr beneath the cathedral
steps.hint: Use the hidden passage beneath Ymir’s throne and ring the third bell.
steps.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

steps.title: Return and defeat Count Ymir
steps.hint: After Metyr, return to the throne and finish the encounters.
steps.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
description: Speak with Ymir’s swordhand and choose the reward at the end of her route.
warning: Her Iris of Occultation and Iris of Grace rewards are mutually exclusive for the current journey.

notes.label: Iris choices
notes.text: Grace grants Jolán’s Spirit Ash. Occultation grants the Sword of Night.

notes.label: Anna
notes.text: With Jolán’s Spirit Ash, reach the upper part of Rabbath’s Rise via the Hinterland cliff route to combine her with Anna.

giver.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

steps.title: Speak to Jolán beside the cathedral pillar
steps.hint: Repeat after sounding the hanging bells while following Ymir’s quest.
steps.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

steps.title: Choose an iris for Jolán
steps.hint: After resolving Ymir’s encounters, speak to Jolán at her pillar.
steps.place: Cathedral of Manus Metyr · Scadu Altus

name: Fire Knight Queelign
region: Realm of Shadow · Belurat, Tower Settlement
description: Defeat Queelign’s invasions and find him in the Prayer Room.
warning: Giving him an Iris of Grace or an Iris of Occultation commits to one reward.

notes.label: Iris choices
notes.text: Grace grants Fire Knight Queelign’s Spirit Ash. Occultation grants Queelign’s Greatsword.

giver.place: Small Private Altar · Belurat, Tower Settlement

steps.title: Defeat Queelign in Belurat
steps.hint: Explore the courtyard reached from Small Private Altar to trigger the first invasion.
steps.place: Small Private Altar · Belurat, Tower Settlement

steps.title: Defeat Queelign at the Church of the Crusade
steps.hint: Travel northwest of Highroad Cross to the church. Winning both invasions grants the Prayer Room Key.

steps.title: Open the Prayer Room and choose an iris
steps.hint: Use the key at the Prayer Room in Shadow Keep’s Church District.
steps.place: Church District Entrance · Shadow Keep, Church District

name: Igon
description: Follow Igon to Jagged Peak and help him fight Bayle.
warning: Speak to Igon after the drake encounter and take his finger before fighting Bayle if you want to summon him.

notes.label: Summon
notes.text: Look just inside Bayle’s arena for Igon’s gold sign. For his equipment, return to the site where you received his finger after the fight.

steps.title: Meet Igon on the road to Dragon’s Pit
steps.hint: Speak to Igon near the path below the grace.

steps.title: Collect Igon’s Furled Finger
steps.hint: Continue beyond Dragon’s Pit, defeat the drake encounter and speak to Igon nearby.
steps.place: Foot of the Jagged Peak · Jagged Peak

steps.title: Defeat Bayle the Dread
steps.hint: Enter the arena and use Igon’s sign if you want his help.

steps.title: Return for Igon’s equipment
steps.hint: Go back to the dragon encounter site and check where you spoke to Igon.
steps.place: Foot of the Jagged Peak · Jagged Peak

name: Dragon Communion Priestess
description: Choose how Florissax’s service ends before defeating Bayle.
warning: To obtain Florissax’s alternate rewards, give her Thiollier’s Concoction at night before defeating Bayle.

notes.label: Two outcomes
notes.text: Defeat Bayle after accepting the blessing for her usual rewards. Put her to sleep first and later confess what happened for her Spirit Ash and incantation.

giver.place: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion · Jagged Peak

steps.title: Speak to the Dragon Communion Priestess
steps.hint: Reach the altar past Dragon’s Pit and speak to Florissax.
steps.place: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion · Jagged Peak

steps.title: Decide whether to use Thiollier’s Concoction
steps.hint: For the alternate route, visit after dark with the concoction. Mark the decision before going to Bayle.
steps.place: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion · Jagged Peak

steps.title: Claim the chosen reward after Bayle
steps.hint: Return after Bayle. Collect the altar rewards or speak to Florissax and tell her what you did.
steps.place: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion · Jagged Peak
